method: Actual Highwall runtime and native keyboard/mouse controls. Each case may arrange initial actor positions and isolate participants, explicitly recorded below; no actor teleports or manually advanced simulation during actions. Read-only instrumentation records native shot contacts and AI intent.

corridor-corners.fixture: Player positioned at unchanged Blue spawn. Bots remain in native READY mode. Route generated from native Highwall nav; only keyboard follows it.

gate-native-pass.fixture: Player positioned south of real service gate; native E operates controller, native W attempts passage. No gate collider edits.

native-projectile-contacts.fixture: Player arranged in front of actual wall then actual low cover between independent firing actions. Native LMB emits existing rifle rounds. Wrapped spawn/commit callbacks only log contacts, retaining original behavior.

flyer-wall-and-occlusion.fixture: Sol positioned below/behind actual cross-wall for sight test, then positioned above the wall once to initialize a separate flight traversal. Actual native W crosses wall; no teleport during flight.

ai-pursuit.fixture: One real zombie spawned using existing zombieDefinition. Other soldiers retain bodies but are assigned the zombie team and AI disabled at fixture setup, leaving the player as the only opponent. Player moves natively from visible contact around reinforced corner; zombie AI perception/memory/routing remain untouched.

tank-native-lane.fixture: Unmodified vehicle preset spawn, native J boards, W/A/D follow native clearance route around actual lane cover, Space brakes and pivots. This is a test driver issuing keys, not an AI crew.

after.controls: Battle tank · 0 km/hW/S drive · A/D steer · Space brake · Alt + mouse look · J exit
